components.name: tf-state
components.reason: Remote state with locking keeps Terraform safe once more than one person or pipeline applies changes (SECURITY.md section 5).

components.name: github-oidc-role
components.sizing: 1 IAM role trusted by GitHub Actions via OIDC
components.reason: CI/CD deploys by assuming a role, so no long-lived AWS keys are stored in GitHub.

components.name: vpc
components.sizing: 2 AZs, public + private subnets, S3 and ECR VPC endpoints
components.reason: Containers and data stores run in private subnets; endpoints avoid NAT data charges for image pulls and S3 traffic.

components.name: ecs-cluster
components.reason: One cluster runs every container service; Fargate means no servers to patch.

components.name: alb
components.reason: One shared load balancer for all web services avoids paying for one per service.

components.name: ecr-api
components.reason: Stores the container image for api.

components.name: ecr-worker
components.reason: Stores the container image for worker.

components.name: elasticache-redis
components.reason: Redis (cache, Celery/BullMQ/RQ broker) on ElastiCache.

components.name: secrets-api
components.reason: These variables look like credentials or connection strings. Slots are created empty; set values yourself, out of band.

components.name: secrets-worker
components.reason: These variables look like credentials or connection strings. Slots are created empty; set values yourself, out of band.

components.name: logs-api
components.reason: CloudWatch logs with an explicit retention so they cannot grow forever.

components.name: logs-worker
components.reason: CloudWatch logs with an explicit retention so they cannot grow forever.

components.name: role-api
components.reason: api gets its own role limited to the resources it uses.

components.name: role-worker
components.reason: worker gets its own role limited to the resources it uses.

components.name: ecs-svc-api
components.reason: Stateless HTTP container behind the shared load balancer.

components.name: ecs-svc-worker
components.reason: Background worker: a Fargate service with no load balancer.

components.name: autoscaling-api
components.reason: Scales api with load instead of a fixed task count; the bounds are defaults and live in var.service_scaling.

components.name: autoscaling-worker
components.reason: Scales worker with load instead of a fixed task count; the bounds are defaults and live in var.service_scaling.

components.name: alerts
components.reason: One place where every alarm is delivered. The topic is not KMS-encrypted because CloudWatch cannot publish to a topic that uses the AWS-managed key.

components.name: alarms
components.sizing: CloudWatch alarms on errors, saturation, storage and queue depth
components.reason: Without alarms nobody is told when a service, database or queue starts failing.

unknowns: Alarm thresholds are defaults, and alerts reach nobody until the e-mail subscription for var.alert_email is confirmed.
Domain name and ACM certificate are needed for HTTPS on the load balancer.
Redis: in-transit encryption is on, so clients must connect with TLS (rediss://); check each service's Redis client settings.
Traffic and data volume are unknown: all sizing is a default starting point.
